Rent Increase Limits
Maximum rent increase:
match: Your landlord can only raise your rent by a certain amount each year. The increase cannot be more than 3% of your current rent or 80% of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) change, whichever is less.
after:
Renter Protections
Just cause evictions:
Your landlord must have a valid reason to evict you. This could be for not paying rent, breaking the lease, or if the landlord wants to move into the property themselves.
Relocation assistance:
If your landlord evicts you for certain reasons, they might have to help pay for your moving costs.
Petitions
Both landlords and tenants may submit official petitions to request rent adjustments, report violations, or contest unauthorized pass-through costs. Our impartial hearing process ensures all parties are treated fairly under the Ordinance.
